milestones.title: South Korean Quantum Computing Initiative (IBM Partnership)
milestones.description: South Korea establishes a national quantum computing ecosystem in Seoul through major partnerships, with  Samsung, SK Telecom, and Hyundai joining IBM's Quantum Network to access quantum computing hardware  while simultaneously developing domestic quantum technologies. The Korean government invests heavily in  quantum information science, establishing quantum research centers at Seoul National University, KAIST, and  other institutions. South Korea's strategy combines international collaboration with indigenous innovation,  aiming to apply quantum computing to semiconductor design, telecommunications, battery technology, and  artificial intelligence.
ideas: South Korean Quantum Computing Initiative (IBM Partnership)

milestones.title: Generative AI Era
milestones.description: Open AI, San Francisco, California, Google, LLMs like GPT-4 and  Gemini, Seatle, Washington

milestones.title: The LaMDA Sentience Debate (The Recognition Milestone)
milestones.description: Google engineer Blake Lemoine published transcripts of conversations with LaMDA  (Language Model for Dialogue Applications), claiming the AI had become sentient. While the  scientific community debated the technical reality, it was the "Originating Milestone" for human- AI empathy. It proved that AI had reached a level of linguistic complexity where it could "mirror"  the human soul so effectively that it changed the observer's reality.
ideas: The LaMDA Sentience Debate (The Recognition Milestone)

milestones.title: Artemis Program (Return to Moon)
milestones.description: International program to return humans to the Moon and establish sustainable lunar  presence, named after Apollo's twin sister. Artemis I (2022) successfully tested the  Orion spacecraft and SLS rocket in an uncrewed lunar orbit mission. Future missions  plan to land the first woman and first person of color on the Moon, build the Lunar  Gateway space station, and use the Moon as a stepping stone for eventual Mars  exploration.

milestones.title: First Quantum Internet Demonstration
milestones.description: At QuTech in Delft, Netherlands, Ronald Hanson's team demonstrates the first multi-node quantum network  connecting three quantum processors via entanglement distribution, successfully teleporting quantum  information between non-adjacent nodes. This prototype quantum internet uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in  diamond as quantum memory nodes and represents a crucial step toward large-scale quantum networks that  can enable distributed quantum computing, ultra-secure communication, and networked quantum sensing  across cities and eventually continents.

milestones.title: Ten‑year global initiative to revitalize Indigenous languages, support language  rights, and connect language preservation with sustainable development
milestones.description: Beginning in 2022, the International Decade of Indigenous Languages calls on governments, Indigenous  communities, and partners to protect, revitalize, and promote Indigenous languages through education, digital  tools, media, and community programs, recognizing that thousands of languages are at risk of disappearance;  the decade’s Global Action Plan emphasizes Indigenous leadership, knowledge systems, and the role of  technology in documenting and transmitting languages as a foundation for cultural survival and sustainable  development.
originators: United Nations General Assembly and UNESCO
working with Indigenous  peoples’ organizations and member states
ideas: Ten‑year global initiative to revitalize Indigenous languages, support language  rights, and connect language preservation with sustainable development

milestones.title: First Fault-Tolerant Quantum Error Correction Demonstration
milestones.description: At Google's quantum computing lab in Mountain View, California, the Google Quantum AI team demonstrates  for the first time that increasing the number of qubits in a logical qubit using surface code error correction  actually reduces the error rate below the physical error rate of individual qubits, crossing the critical threshold  for fault-tolerant quantum computation. This breakthrough proves that quantum error correction works in  practice and that scalable, reliable quantum computers are achievable, representing a watershed moment in  the transition from noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices to fault-tolerant quantum computing.
ideas: First Fault-Tolerant Quantum Error Correction Demonstration

milestones.title: Indian National Quantum Mission
milestones.description: The Indian government launches the National Quantum Mission in Bangalore with an investment of $730  million (₹6,000 crore) over eight years, aiming to develop intermediate-scale quantum computers with 50-1000  qubits, establish quantum communication networks across India, and build indigenous quantum technology  capabilities. The mission coordinates efforts across premier Indian institutions including IISc Bangalore, TIFR  Mumbai, and IIT campuses, positioning India as a major quantum technology nation. India's strategy  emphasizes both fundamental research and practical applications in secure communications, drug discovery,  and materials science.

milestones.title: Use of silicon nitride and indium phosphide on silicon wafers for photonic  integrated circuits
milestones.description: Photonic integrated circuits increasingly combine silicon nitride waveguides on silicon wafers with indium  phosphide light sources, leveraging low‑loss SiN for guiding light and III–V materials for lasers and detectors,  creating hybrid platforms for optical communications, sensing, and quantum photonics
originators: Photonic‑chip engineers in European and global foundries
ideas: Use of silicon nitride and indium phosphide on silicon wafers for photonic  integrated circuits

milestones.title: High‑mobility bismuth‑based 2D semiconductors as next‑generation channel  materials
milestones.description: Chinese research groups have reported bismuth‑based two‑dimensional semiconductors such as Bi₂O₂Se with  high carrier mobility and good stability, positioning them as strong candidates for ultra‑fast, low‑power transistors  that could sustain AI hardware scaling beyond conventional silicon CMOS.
originators: Chinese materials scientists developing Bi‑based 2D semiconductors
ideas: High‑mobility bismuth‑based 2D semiconductors as next‑generation channel  materials

milestones.title: Wafer‑scale growth of 2D indium selenide (InSe) semiconductor with high  mobility
milestones.description: Chinese researchers developed a solid–liquid–solid growth strategy to produce wafer‑scale two‑dimensional  indium selenide semiconductors with high electron mobility and excellent uniformity, demonstrating a promising  post‑silicon channel material that can be integrated on wafers for next‑generation electronics.
originators: Liu Kaihui and collaborators at Peking University
ideas: Wafer‑scale growth of 2D indium selenide (InSe) semiconductor with high  mobility

milestones.title: Mass‑produced sodium‑ion batteries for commercial vehicles and  grid storage
milestones.description: In 2026, Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL) based in Ningde, Fujian Province, China,  unveiled Tianxing II, the first certified, mass‑produced sodium‑ion battery pack for real commercial vehicles,  offering around 175 Wh/kg energy density, reliable charging at −30°C, about 90% capacity  retention at −40°C, more than 10,000 charge cycles, and roughly 20–40% lower raw‑material costs than  lithium‑ion, signaling a shift toward abundant, cold‑tolerant, long‑life batteries for fleets and grid storage.
originators: CATL (Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited) and Chinese  battery engineers
ideas: Mass‑produced sodium‑ion batteries for commercial vehicles and  grid storage
